dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: 1. A central, small 'O' annulus with a sharp, high-contrast white perimeter transitioning to a darker interior. 2. A large, irregular 'C'-shaped structure to the right with a jagged outer perimeter. 3. A partially closed dorsal annulus showing a crisp gradient from the dark background to a light-intensity edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid high-intensity white blobs concentrated along the lower lateral flank. A secondary, less dense cluster of irregular light blobs is visible in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An obtuse triangle formed by the spatial centroids of the central 'O' annulus, the large 'C' structure to its right, and the primary mid-dorsal blob cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of interconnected, chain-like light pigment loops extending horizontally along the lower longitudinal axis.
